posts.content: Latest posts will appear here once the GitHub Actions workflow runs and fetches from Nostr relays. The workflow runs hourly.
Make sure to check the Actions tab on GitHub to see if the workflow ran successfully.
You can manually trigger the workflow from the Actions tab to fetch posts immediately.
Once working, this section will show your latest 5 Nostr posts from npub1g8ag22auywa5c5de6w9ujenpyhrrp9qq8sjzram02xldttmmwurqfd0hqk
Check the GitHub repository workflow logs if posts aren't showing after a few minutes.
